title: Director of Business Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: This role within HP's Large Format Printing division is responsible for identifying and executing strategic partnerships with materials suppliers, finishing solution providers, and ecosystem partners that complement HP's printer technology. The Director of Business Development would evaluate Tedlar as a co-marketing and technical validation partner to create bundled solutions for HP's customer base of sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers. This role's KPIs include: (1) Revenue growth through ecosystem expansion - creating new revenue streams by connecting HP customers with validated materials partners, (2) Customer retention - ensuring HP customers achieve successful outcomes that drive repeat printer purchases and consumables revenue, (3) Market penetration in premium segments - targeting high-value applications where durability and longevity justify higher total solution costs, (4) Competitive win rates against Canon, Epson, and Roland large-format systems. With HP exhibiting at major industry events and launching new outdoor-focused printer models, this role is actively pursuing partnerships that position HP as the complete solution provider for durable outdoor graphics, making Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan a compelling differentiator for HP's sales messaging.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This Director owns strategic partnership development for HP's Large Format Printing division, specifically focused on ecosystem expansion beyond hardware. They identify materials suppliers and finishing solution providers that enhance the value proposition of HP's Latex, Stitch, DesignJet, and Latex R series printers. They likely report to VP-level leadership in the Large Format business unit and work cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, and Sales teams. This role has authority to initiate partnership discussions, evaluate technical fit, and structure co-marketing or channel programs that drive revenue growth through HP's print service provider customer base.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: HP's customer base directly maps to Tedlar's core applications: (1) Sign manufacturers and fabricators using HP Latex printers for outdoor signage would benefit from Tedlar overlaminates that extend graphic lifespan from 3-5 years to 12-20+ years, reducing replacement costs and warranty claims, (2) Vehicle wrap installers using HP Latex systems for fleet graphics would value Tedlar's graffiti resistance (spray paint and marker removal) and extreme temperature tolerance (-70°F to 230°F), especially for municipal fleets and commercial vehicles, (3) Architectural graphics producers using HP Latex R Series for building wraps and facades would leverage Tedlar's UV protection (no yellowing or fading) and weather resistance to deliver premium, maintenance-free installations that justify higher project pricing. For HP's business development agenda, Tedlar represents a validated finishing solution that differentiates HP printing systems in competitive evaluations and creates recurring revenue opportunities through materials partnerships.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This Director is measured on ecosystem revenue contribution, customer retention rates for HP printer owners, and competitive win rates against Canon, Epson, and Roland in premium outdoor graphics segments. They personally care about: (1) Creating partnership programs that drive incremental revenue without requiring HP capital investment in manufacturing or inventory, (2) Reducing customer churn by ensuring HP customers achieve the outdoor durability outcomes promised in HP's marketing (graphics that 'withstand the test of time'), (3) Arming HP's sales force with differentiated solution stories that close deals in competitive situations, (4) Building case studies and proof points that demonstrate measurable ROI for HP customers who adopt validated finishing materials. Tedlar's extreme durability and reduced maintenance costs directly address the pain point of premature graphic failure that can undermine customer satisfaction and trigger warranty issues for HP's print service provider customers.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: HP is exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) with a 4,000-square-foot booth (#4249), presenting an immediate opportunity to discuss partnership visibility at this event. The company recently launched the HP Latex R530 hybrid printer at FESPA Global Print Expo 2025 (May 6-9, Berlin) and the Latex 700/800 series with white ink capability, indicating active product innovation cycles where ecosystem partnerships can be integrated into go-to-market strategies. HP's return to The Sign Show 2025 (September 23-25, Birmingham UK) after a six-year absence signals renewed focus on the signage market. Additionally, HP's emphasis on outdoor durability and UV resistance in current marketing messaging creates natural alignment for conversations about validated overlaminate solutions that substantiate these claims with third-party performance data.

personalization_hooks.hook: HP markets 'white ink that resists yellowing over time' and 'graphics that withstand the test of time' but lacks a validated overlaminate partner to substantiate these durability claims with third-party data
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open with recognition of HP's outdoor durability messaging, then position Tedlar as the missing piece that provides measurable proof points for HP's sales conversations—turning marketing claims into defensible technical specifications that differentiate HP systems from Canon and Epson in competitive evaluations

personalization_hooks.hook: HP's 4,000-square-foot booth at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) represents a major investment in market presence, creating urgency for partnership discussions that could enhance booth messaging and lead generation
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference HP's upcoming PRINTING United presence and suggest a pre-show conversation about how Tedlar could be featured in HP's booth demonstrations or technical literature to showcase complete outdoor graphics solutions—providing a concrete, near-term collaboration opportunity rather than an abstract partnership discussion

personalization_hooks.hook: HP's recent launch of the Latex R530 hybrid printer and Latex 700/800 series with white ink indicates active go-to-market cycles where ecosystem partnerships can be integrated into launch strategies and customer education programs
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as a strategic launch partner for HP's outdoor-focused printer innovations—offering to create co-branded technical guides, durability comparison studies, or customer success stories that help HP's sales teams position these new systems in premium architectural graphics and building wrap applications where extreme durability justifies higher project pricing

recommended_approach: Lead with the PRINTING United Expo timing hook to create urgency, then pivot to the strategic partnership opportunity around HP's outdoor durability messaging. Emphasize Tedlar as an ecosystem revenue opportunity rather than a materials supplier—focus on how validated overlaminate partnerships help HP differentiate against competitors, improve customer retention, and penetrate premium market segments. Include a specific ask for a 20-minute exploratory call to discuss partnership models (co-marketing, technical validation, channel programs) rather than a generic 'let's connect' request.
